data.mqtt_topic_prefix: Frigate MQTT topic prefix (leave default unless you changed it in Frigate's own config)
data.subscribe_to_frigate_events: Subscribe to Frigate events (leave unchecked if a "Notifications for Android TV" blueprint already pushes to this TV — enabling both shows every event twice)
data.register_companion_app: Register as a Home Assistant companion app (lets it show up as a notify target in blueprints)
data.companion_device_name: Companion app device name (only used if registering above)

user.title: Set up Egret NVR TV
user.description: Enter the TV's address if it wasn't found automatically.

data.mqtt_topic_prefix: Frigate MQTT topic prefix (leave default unless you changed it in Frigate's own config)
data.subscribe_to_frigate_events: Subscribe to Frigate events (leave unchecked if a "Notifications for Android TV" blueprint already pushes to this TV or you plan on using the companion app support for notification — enabling both shows every event twice)
data.register_companion_app: Register as a Home Assistant companion app (lets it show up as a notify target in blueprints)
data.companion_device_name: Companion app device name (only used if registering above)

alert_settings.title: Alert appearance & history
alert_settings.description: How alerts should look on "{name}", and how much notification history to keep.

data.play_clips_inline: Play video clips inline in the alert popup (instead of full-screen). Pressing arrow up will switch to fullscreen during playback
data.save_all_notifications: Save every notification to history (not just ones with a stable event ID that Frigate provides)

pin.title: Enter the code shown on the TV
pin.description: "{name}" is showing a pairing code on screen. Enter it here to finish connecting.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV. Make sure it's on the same network and try again.
error.invalid_pin: That code didn't match, or it expired. The TV is showing a new one — enter that instead.
error.no_local_url: Home Assistant doesn't have a local URL configured (Settings > System > Network) — needed so the TV knows where to reach this instance.
